problem:
Given the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 0 \\ -4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],$ find ${A}^{-1}$ by performing row operations.
worked_solution:
We consider the augmented matrix $[A\,|\,I]$ where $I$ is the $3\times 3$ identity matrix. Applying the indicated row operations we have

$$
\begin{aligned}[A\,|\,I] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ -4 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & {R}_{1}:=(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ -4 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] &  & {R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & -1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}] &  \\  & =[I\,|\,{A}^{-1}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the inverse matrix is 

$$
{A}^{-1}=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 & 0 \\ -4 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$
